{{CharInfobox |color={{water color}} |corecolor={{water color light}} |bordercolor={{water color dark}} |name=Captain Stern |jname=クスノキ館長 |tmname=Director Kusunoki |slogan=no |image=Captain Stern.png |size=250px |caption=Captain Stern in {{aniseries|AG}} |gender=Male |age=yes |years=57{{sup/6|ORAS}}{{g|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire}}: ''We have a new update regarding the strange attack on the Oceanic Museum’s director, Captain Stern, aged 57, by parties unknown.'' - {{DL|TV Mauville|Hoenn News Network}} |hometown=[[Slateport City]] |region=[[Hoenn]] |trainer=no |game=yes |generation={{gen|III}}, {{gen|VI}} |games={{game3|Ruby and Sapphire|Ruby, Sapphire|s}}, {{v2|Emerald}}, {{pkmn|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire|Omega Ruby, Alpha Sapphire}} |leader=no |anime=yes |epnum=AG036 |epname=The Spheal of Approval |enva=[[David Wills]] |java=Mitsuaki Hoshino }} '''Captain Stern''' (Japanese: '''クスノキ館長''' ''Director Kusunoki'') is an oceanographer who lives in [[Slateport City]]. ==In the games== Due to his occupation, Captain Stern is responsible for a lot of the town's livelihood. He constructed the [[S.S. Tidal]], a ship transporting people to and from [[Lilycove City]] and Slateport City. He also built the [[Oceanic Museum]], and runs [[Stern's Shipyard]]. He ordered the [[Devon Parts|Devon Goods/Parts]] from [[Rustboro City]]. [[Team Magma]] or [[Team Aqua]] will threaten him in the Oceanic Museum to try to recover the Devon Goods, which are plans for a new submarine engine for Stern's next project — [[Submarine Explorer 1]]. After gaining access to the HMs {{m|Dive}} and {{m|Surf}}, the player can go to the [[Abandoned Ship]]{{sup/3|RSE}}/[[Sea Mauville]]{{sup/6|ORAS}} in hopes of finding a [[Scanner]]. For {{3v2|Ruby|Sapphire|Emerald}}, in exchange for that item, Captain Stern will offer either a [[Deep Sea Scale|DeepSeaScale]] or [[Deep Sea Tooth|DeepSeaTooth]] in return, both of which are required for {{p|Clamperl}} to evolve into {{p|Gorebyss}} and {{p|Huntail}}, respectively. In {{pkmn|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire}}, Captain Stern instead gives the player the [[Clear Bell]]{{sup/6|OR}} or [[Tidal Bell]]{{sup/6|AS}}, which is required to encounter {{p|Ho-Oh}}{{sup/6|OR}} or {{p|Lugia}}{{sup/6|AS}} on Sea Mauville. ==Gallery== {{missing image|section|ORAS model}} ===Sprites and models=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; font-size:80%; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{Water color dark}}; background: #{{Water color}}" | style="{{roundy|80px}} border: 2px solid #{{Water color dark}}; background: #{{Water color light}}; width:80px; height:80px"| [[File:Scientist RSE OD.png]] |- |Overworld sprite from
{{color2|000|Generation III}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Captain Stern/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===History=== Captain Stern's appears in the {{aniseries|RS}} episode ''[[AG036|The Spheal of Approval]]''. He is the curator of {{ci|Slateport}}'s [[Oceanic Museum]], a marine biologist and runs a [[Stern's Shipyard|local shipbuilding business]]. He was introduced to {{Ash}} and [[Max]] when his young friend {{OBP|Marius|AG036}} battled them and lost. Captain Stern stepped in and mentioned he had been looking for Marius before taking the boys on a guided tour of the museum. The museum had many sculptures of {{type|Water}} Pokémon and models of submarines. Captain Stern also showed off his latest find, a volcanic rock formed by underwater volcanoes, supposedly created by the [[Legendary Pokémon]], {{p|Groudon}}. While the kids went to go get snow cones, members of [[Team Magma]] broke into the museum and stole the stone. Ash helped Captain Stern handle [[Tabitha]] and his accomplice grunts while Max and Marius were ordered to alert [[Officer Jenny]] to the situation. Ash managed to gain possession of the case, but soon dropped it trying to avoid a {{m|Shadow Ball}} from a {{p|Mightyena}}. As a result the stone broke into two pieces, and Team Magma fled with the larger portion. Later, Ash apologized to Captain Stern for letting Team Magma escape, but Stern was grateful to just keep half of the stone so he could study it. ===Pokémon=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Captain Stern |pkmn=Sealeo |type1=Ice |type2=Water |img=Captain Stern Sealeo.png |img_size=195px |epnum=AG036 |epname=The Spheal of Approval |vajp= |vaen=Maddie Blaustein |desc=Captain Stern sent out {{p|Sealeo}} to take care of [[Team Magma]]. It battled with their three {{p|Mightyena}} by teaming up with [[Ash's Pikachu]] and {{AP|Corphish}}. When Captain Stern told Ash to take the briefcase with him, Sealeo continued the battle on its own by distracting all but one of the members. Sealeo's known moves are {{m|Aurora Beam}} and {{m|Blizzard}}.}} ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{water color}}|bordercolor={{water color light}} |ja=星野充昭 ''Mitsuaki Hoshino'' |en=[[David Wills]] |ar=فادي الرفاعي ''Fadi Rifai'' |fr_eu=Jean-Marc Delhausse |pt_br=Faduli Costa |es_eu=Miguel Ángel Montero |pl=Dariusz Błażejewski}} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Captain Stern Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Captain Stern in Pokémon Adventures]] In the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}, Captain Stern appears in a supporting role. {{adv|Ruby}} came to Slateport to enter a [[Pokémon Contest]] when [[Team Magma]] attacked, looking for Captain Stern. They kidnapped Stern, Ruby, the [[Pokémon Fan Club Chairman]], and [[Dock]]. Team Magma wanted to use Submarine Explorer 1 to reach the [[Seafloor Cavern]], the deepest part of Hoenn's ocean. However, a special starter developed by the [[Devon Corporation]] and transported in the Devon Goods was needed. Ruby saved Captain Stern but ended up drifting away in the submarine. During the conflict, Stern ended up being poisoned by a {{p|Torkoal}}. Later, Captain Stern was able to inform [[Norman]], and [[Gabby and Ty]] of Ruby's location. When {{p|Kyogre}} flooded half of Hoenn, Stern helped evacuate the people of Slateport into ships, including the [[S.S. Tidal]]. Captain Stern is apparently friends with both [[Steven Stone]] and [[Wallace]]. He later appears in ''[[PS605|Swampert Smashes]]'', where he and Dock were seen watching the news about the [[Grand Meteor Delta|meteor]] that was about to hit the planet in several days. ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{water color}}; border:3px solid #{{water color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{water color light}}" | Language ! style="background:#{{water color light}}" | Name ! style="background:#{{water color light}}" | Origin |- | Japanese | クスノキ館長 ''Director Kusunoki-kanchō'' | From 樟 ''kusunoki'' ({{wp|Cinnamomum camphora|camphor tree}}) |- | English | Captain Stern | From ''{{wp|stern}}'' |- | German | Kapitän Brigg | From ''Brigg'' ({{wp|brig}}) |- | European Spanish | Babor | From ''babor'' ({{wp|Port and starboard|port}}) |- | French | Capitaine Poupe | From ''poupe'' (stern) |- | Italian | Remo | From ''remo'' ({{wp|oar}}) |- | Korean | 해양관장 ''Haeyang-gwanjang'' | From 해양 (海洋) ''haeyang'' (ocean) |- | Chinese (Taiwan) | 庫斯諾吉館長 ''Kùsīnuòjí-guǎnzhǎng''[[Pokémon animated series]], [[Pokémon Adventures]] | rowspan="2" | Transcription of his Japanese name |- | Chinese (Hong Kong) | 庫斯諾吉館長 ''Fusīnohkgāt-gúnjéung'' |- | Chinese (mainland China) | 楠木馆长 ''Nánmù-guǎnzhǎng''Pokémon Adventures (Shanghai VIZ)
